title: UAAP: UST women stay in Final 4 hunt after 3-0 win over National U
summary: University of Santo Tomas is still alive in the race to the UAAP Season 89 women's football Final 4 after a 3-0 triumph over National University on Saturday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
